info.description: Project 03 portofolio Junior QA (mfaizdinar8) — Manual API testing di JSONPlaceholder (https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com). 15 test cases: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE + negative testing. Dijalankan dengan Postman CLI v1.94.0.
info.name: Project 03 - JSONPlaceholder API Testing

exec: pm.test('TC-01.1 Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('TC-01.2 Response is JSON', function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });
pm.test('TC-01.3 Content-Type is application/json', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/json'); });
pm.test('TC-01.4 id is 1', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('TC-01.5 userId is 1', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().userId).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('TC-01.6 Response body is not empty', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().body).to.not.be.empty; });
pm.test('TC-02.1 Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('TC-02.2 Response is a JSON array', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('TC-02.3 Array has 100 posts', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().length).to.eql(100); });
pm.test('TC-02.4 Every post has id, userId, title, body', function () { pm.response.json().forEach(function (p) { pm.expect(p).to.have.all.keys('userId', 'id', 'title', 'body'); }); });
pm.test('TC-03.1 Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('TC-03.2 Returns 10 posts for userId=1', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().length).to.eql(10); });
pm.test('TC-03.3 All posts belong to userId 1', function () { pm.response.json().forEach(function (p) { pm.expect(p.userId).to.eql(1); }); });
pm.test('TC-04.1 Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('TC-04.2 Returns 5 comments for post 1', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().length).to.eql(5); });
pm.test('TC-04.3 All comments belong to postId 1', function () { pm.response.json().forEach(function (c) { pm.expect(c.postId).to.eql(1); }); });
pm.test('TC-05.1 Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('TC-05.2 id is 1', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql(1); });

pm.test('TC-05.3 Has name, username and email', function () { var u = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(u.name).to.not.be.empty; pm.expect(u.username).to.not.be.empty; pm.expect(u.email).to.not.be.empty; });
pm.test('TC-05.4 Email format is valid', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().email).to.include('@'); });
pm.test('TC-06.1 Status code is 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('TC-06.2 Returns new id 101', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql(101); });
pm.test('TC-06.3 Echoes submitted title', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().title).to.eql('QA Test Post'); });
pm.test('TC-06.4 Echoes submitted body and userId', function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.body).to.eql('Created by Postman CLI test'); pm.expect(j.userId).to.eql(1); });

item.name: TC-09 PUT Update Post 1, full body (positive)

exec: // Save the original body BEFORE patching, so the test can compare values explicitly.
pm.sendRequest('https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1', function (err, res) {
if (!err) { pm.collectionVariables.set('prePatchBody', res.json().body); }
pm.test('TC-10.1 Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('TC-10.2 id stays 1', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('TC-10.3 Title is patched', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().title).to.eql('patched title'); });

pm.test('TC-10.4 Body value is preserved from before PATCH', function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.userId).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.body).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('prePatchBody')); });
